items.title: Thousands struggling without water after a major leak in a pipeline in Kolkata’s Tala area
items.text: According to the Kolkata Municipal Corporation, over 5 million gallons of water have been gushed out after the 72-inch pipeline got damaged on Monday (November 9, 2026) morning

items.title: Ambekar Meetei storms into men’s 50kg final at Youth Olympics
items.text: Ambekar Meetei reaches Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics boxing final after a dominant 5-0 win, ending 16-year wait for India.

items.title: Aaryavir in focus as India face Afghanistan in U-19 Asia Cup semifinal
items.text: Aaryavir is the tournament’s leading run-scorer after smashing 160 off 168 balls to guide India to a 70-run win over the UAE in their final Group A match

items.title: Anti-Sterlite protests: CM orders ₹5.25-cr. additional relief to victims
items.text: TN CM orders ₹5.25 crore extra relief for Thoothukudi anti-Sterlite victims, boosting per-family compensation to ₹50 lakh for deceased and ₹10 lakh for grievous injuries.

items.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases, causes 5,387 deaths
items.text: The 17th outbreak of the virus in the DRC's history was officially declared in May, but experts believe it emerged weeks or even months earlier
